column3: Popup content parts of the UI SDK families stay display:none until their element is defined, through one unlayered :where(ui-combobox-content, ui-menu-content, ui-menu-sub-content, ui-trigger-menu-content, ui-popover-content, ui-select-content, ui-hover-card-content):not(:defined) rule in web/src/styles/app.css; triggers, inputs, segmented controls and toggles still paint at startup
column4: XIN-33 live run: on a fresh load of #/p/ingle the model and effort pickers' content painted under the composer before customElements.get('ui-combobox') was true, because an undefined element is a plain inline box and its POPUP utility classes (flex, border, padding) still apply. The rule is unlayered so it wins over Tailwind's display utilities in @layer utilities
